subject: Procurement & Commercial Path - next steps / budget owners (Acme)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + next steps from discovery (procurement / commercial path)

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on procurement readiness and the commercial path: 

Summary from our call:
- Acme is evaluating Redwood for inference (batch + real-time) across product teams.
- Primary checklist items for procurement: PO vs card payment, vendor paperwork (W-9, COI), standard SOW, and whether AWS Marketplace is preferred.
- Timeline: target contract signing within April if approvals align.

Action items / questions for Acme:
1) Payment method: do you expect to procure via Purchase Order (PO) or corporate card? If PO, does procurement require Net 30/45/60 terms or an exact PO flow?
2) Marketplace: is AWS Marketplace preferred for procurement (SaaS contract via marketplace) or do you want a vendor contract routed to procurement for a direct PO?
3) Budget & approvals: please confirm the economic buyer, finance sponsor, and final signatory (I.e., who needs to sign contracts >$100k).
4) Attachments: I can send a short procurement checklist + our standard SOW for your legal/procurement review. Would you prefer via Drive link or attached PDF/Word?

Proposed Redwood next steps:
- I will share the procurement checklist and SOW template (attached) for your team to review.
- If Acme prefers PO, we can align on required fields (billing address, remit-to, PO referencing).
- We can schedule a procurement-focused call next week with procurement/finance once you confirm the right stakeholders.

If you can reply with the answers for items 1-3 (PO vs card, marketplace preference, budget owner names) that would be super helpful.

Thanks,

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Acme_Procurement_Checklist.pdf, Acme_SOW_Template.docx

From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: Sat, 21 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps from discovery (procurement / commercial path)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming answers below and attaching a filled procurement checklist: 

1) Payment method: Acme prefers to purchase via Purchase Order. Standard internal terms are Net 30 - procurement will issue PO once contracts are finalized.

2) Marketplace: we generally prefer AWS Marketplace for smaller SaaS purchases, but for platform/vendor relationships at this scale we route direct PO to vendors. For Redwood, procurement is open to both; they will confirm whether marketplace listing is required for this purchase.

3) Budget & approvals: 
- Economic buyer: Paul Gomez (CFO) - paul.gomez@acme.com
- Finance sponsor: Tina Rivera (Finance Manager) - tina.rivera@acme.com
- Final signatory for contracts >$100k: Dave Morris (VP Ops) - dave.morris@acme.com

I have copied procurement@acme.com on this thread. Attached is our procurement checklist and our internal vendor onboarding form. I can also send a PO template once we reach contract language agreement.

We expect to confirm the internal budget owner by COB Monday.

Best,
Sarah
Director of Product 
Acme Corp

Vivek / Aditya —

FW: Acme confirmed PO preference (Net 30) and provided budget/approval contacts. They attached their procurement checklist and vendor onboarding form. Key asks:
- They expect a direct PO for a platform-level engagement; marketplace is optional but procurement will confirm.
- Economic buyer: Paul Gomez; Finance sponsor: Tina Rivera; Signatory: Dave Morris.

Can we prepare: 
- A terse SOW and commercial summary (line items / MRR or committed GPUs) that procurement can reference in the PO?
- Pricing/term options if they want to go through AWS Marketplace vs direct PO (implications on billing cadence and fees).
- Legal: are there any non-standard clauses we should flag ahead of procurement review (data residency/KMS, audit logs, SLA credits)?

Suggested next step: set a procurement call with Acme procurement + our legal/commercial to walk the checklist. Sarah mentioned they can confirm budget owner by COB Mon - should we aim for a call Wed 24th or Thu 25th?

Thanks - I'm happy to own scheduling and send the checklist + SOW once we have the commercial sheet.

--
Marissa
